title: Stage 7 shot extraction from scene script
summary: Single Gemini call producing the full shot list for one scene with a 9-section system prompt (global context, scene context, prior end-state, camera direction sections, breakdown rules, JSON schema). Output is parsed, validated, and IDs regenerated server-side before persistence.
notes: Model resolves to request.model || GEMINI_MODEL || gemini-1.5-flash (llm-client.ts:106); GEMINI_MODEL value UNKNOWN. Temperature 0.3, maxTokens 4096. Tests exercise the service with mocked llmClient, not the route.
context_inputs: scene script_excerpt, scene_number, prior scene end_state_summary, Stage 3 locked beats, Stage 4 locked formatted script INT/EXT summary, location_views directions for resolved scene location, expected_location name (route projects.ts:1716-1830)
output_parse: Strip json code fences; JSON.parse; validateShot requires non-empty action, setting, camera and duration 1-30 if present; invalid shots dropped; shot_id regenerated via generateShotId(sceneNumber, index); camera enums from LLM else parseCameraMetadata regex fallback; new directions from new_directions plus inline camera_direction names not already existing
retry_fallback: Promise.race with 20 s timeout returns empty result; RATE_LIMIT rethrown (route returns 429); JSON parse failure triggers one retry via V8-AI-02; llm-client retries retryable errors (RATE_LIMIT, 5xx, network) up to 3 times with 1 s base exponential backoff capped at 10 s
persistence: Route inserts shots (shot_order = index), location_views rows (source stage7_inferred), and location_match_events per shot (projects.ts:1832-1969)
trigger: POST /api/projects/:id/scenes/:sceneId/shots/extract; called by Stage7ShotList mount only when GET shots returns zero rows

title: Stage 7 shot extraction retry prompt (malformed JSON fallback)
summary: Second, materially distinct system prompt used once when the first extraction response fails JSON.parse. Shares the user prompt and output parser of V8-AI-01; if it also fails the service returns an empty shot list.
notes: Reachable only when first response is not parseable JSON. Uses extractWithLLM so temperature 0.3 and maxTokens 4096 apply. Not in a timeout race.
system_prompt_src: backend/src/services/shotExtractionService.ts:319-322 (inline short prompt: 'You extract a shot list from screenplay text. Return ONLY valid JSON...')
context_inputs: user prompt only (scene content and shot count instruction); no global, prior-scene, or location context in system prompt
output_parse: Same parseResponse fence strip and JSON.parse as V8-AI-01
retry_fallback: No further retry; on failure logs error and returns { shots: [], newDirections: [] }; caller then throws 'Shot extraction returned no shots' in UI

title: Stage 7 / Stage 9 shot split into 2 or 3 shots
summary: Single Gemini call that splits one shot into N coherent sub-shots from the original shot JSON and optional user guidance. Durations are overwritten server-side with the original duration.
notes: No timeout race and no parse retry in this service. Caller route maps errors whose message contains parse or split to 422, others to 500. Original row is deleted before insert, so an insert failure loses the shot.
system_prompt_src: backend/src/services/shotSplitService.ts:127-144 (template with splitCount, original shot JSON, SPLIT REQUIREMENTS, JSON output template)
context_inputs: original shot shot_id, duration, dialogue, action, characters (foreground/background mapped to prominence), setting, camera, continuity_flags; optional userGuidance; splitCount 2 or 3 (route coerces any non-3 value to 2)
output_parse: Strip json fences; JSON.parse; require new_shots array with at least N entries (slice to N); toShotForInsert maps characters to foreground/background; duration overwritten with originalShot.duration; shot_id = {orig}-1..N; beat_reference null
retry_fallback: None at service level beyond llm-client retries; parse failure throws 'Failed to parse shot split response'; short array throws 'Shot split response must contain exactly N shots'
persistence: Route deletes original shot, shifts shot_order, inserts N shots, clones shot_asset_assignments to each new shot, and fires invalidateStage9AndDownstream (projects.ts:2544-2640)
trigger: POST /api/projects/:id/scenes/:sceneId/shots/:shotId/split from Stage7ShotList Split dialog (performSplit) and from Stage 9 ShotAssetPanel split confirm (no guidance, count default 2)

title: Stage 7 merge of two consecutive shots
summary: Single Gemini call that consolidates two adjacent shots into one shot, given their JSON and optional guidance. Duration is the server-side sum of both shots.
notes: No tests for merge service. Route does not send userGuidance from UI (UI sends only direction). Merged shot does not carry camera_* fields, continuity beyond AI output, or assignments.
context_inputs: both shots as JSON ordered by shot_order (shot_id, duration, dialogue, action, characters, setting, camera, continuity_flags), computed sum duration, optional USER GUIDANCE
output_parse: Strip json fences; JSON.parse; action, setting, camera trimmed and required (throws 'Shot merge response missing required fields (action, setting, camera)'); characters mapped to foreground/background; continuity_flags array; duration = sum; shot_id = {first.shot_id}-M; beat_reference from first shot
retry_fallback: None at service level beyond llm-client retries; parse failure throws 'Failed to parse shot merge response'; route maps messages containing parse or merge to 422
persistence: Route deletes both shots, inserts merged row at lower shot_order, shifts later shots by -1, records location match event (projects.ts:2704-2780)

title: Auto-extract shots when Stage 7 opens an empty scene
summary: On Stage 7 mount the UI fetches shots and, if none exist, calls the LLM extraction route and displays the result. An empty extraction produces an error screen with a reload button.
notes: Functional depends on LLM output quality and latency (runtime-only). Route not tested; service tested only with mocks. Re-extraction on a populated scene is not reachable from UI.
preconditions: Authenticated session; project owned by user; scene on active branch; GET /shots returns zero rows
code_path: Stage7ShotList fetchOrExtractShots -> shotService.fetchShots (GET /shots, projects.ts:1534) -> shotService.extractShots -> POST /shots/extract -> ShotExtractionService.extractShots -> locationResolverService.resolveShotLocation/shouldApplyResolution -> location_views insert (stage7_inferred) -> shots insert -> locationResolverService.recordMatchEvent per shot -> transformShotForClient
data_touched: reads scenes, stage_states (stage 3 and 4 locked content), location_views, project_assets; writes location_views, shots, location_match_events; transformation_flags JSON stored on shots
downstream: Stage 7 table; Stage 8 and Stage 9 read shots via fetchShots; V7 location state derived from location_match_* columns

title: Edit shot fields in Stage 7 inspector (debounced autosave)
summary: Duration, action, dialogue, foreground and background characters, setting, and camera are editable per shot. Edits update local state immediately and persist via a PUT after an 800 ms debounce.
notes: Only setting edits (and camera_direction_id) re-run the location resolver, covered by shotLocationRoutes test 'resolves and persists location fields when shot setting changes'. Edits do not touch prompts or frames (no invalidation).
preconditions: Scene not locked (canEdit true), not saving
code_path: handleShotUpdate -> pendingUpdates Map -> useDebounce 800 ms -> saveUpdates effect -> shotService.updateShot -> PUT /shots/:shotId -> whitelist check -> optional resolver -> shots.update -> optional location_match_events insert -> transformShotForClient
data_touched: shots row (duration, dialogue, action, characters_*, setting, camera, plus location_* when resolver runs), location_match_events
downstream: None in code; prompts (frame_prompt, video_prompt, prompts_generated_at) and frames are not marked stale

title: Split a shot into two (or three) via AI
summary: Split dialog with optional guidance sends the selected shot to the split route; the original row is replaced by AI-generated sub-shots that keep the original duration each.
notes: Non-transactional: delete precedes insert. UI never passes splitCount (default 2). Assignments cloned. Stage 9 prompt cards do not refresh after split from Stage 7 (no state sync).
entrypoint: Stage 7 Split Shot button, then Split dialog confirm
code_path: handleSplitShot -> performSplit -> shotService.splitShot -> POST /shots/:shotId/split -> select original + assignments -> ShotSplitService.splitShot (AI) -> DELETE shot -> shift later shot_order by N-1 -> INSERT N shots (shot_id {orig}-n) -> location_match_events -> clone shot_asset_assignments -> invalidateStage9AndDownstream (fire and forget)
data_touched: shots (delete, update shot_order, insert), shot_asset_assignments (insert), scenes.stage_locks (9-12), location_match_events; cascade deletes frames, video_generation_jobs, image_generation_jobs, transformation_events for original shot
downstream: Stage 9-12 locked stages marked outdated; frames and video jobs of the original shot are cascaded away

title: Merge selected shot with next or previous shot via AI
summary: Merge button combines the selected shot with its adjacent shot (direction toggle Next or Prev) into a single AI-consolidated shot with summed duration.
notes: Adjacency uses shot_order plus or minus 1, so gaps produce a 400 even if UI shows a neighbour. No invalidation of Stage 9-12. No tests.
entrypoint: Stage 7 inspector Merge button with Next/Prev toggle
preconditions: canEdit; selected shot has neighbour in that direction (canMerge)
code_path: handleMergeShot -> shotService.mergeShot -> POST /shots/:shotId/merge -> neighbour lookup by shot_order -> ShotMergeService.mergeShots (AI) -> DELETE current -> DELETE neighbour -> INSERT merged row -> location_match_events -> shift later shot_order -1
data_touched: shots (two deletes, one insert, order updates), location_match_events; cascade deletes frames, jobs, assignments of both original shots
downstream: None in code for Stage 9-12 stage locks

title: Delete a shot (blocked for the last shot)
summary: Delete removes the selected shot with no confirmation dialog. The backend refuses to delete the last remaining shot and the UI offers to defer the scene instead.
notes: Route counts shots twice (first count unused). No shot_order compaction, so later merge adjacency may break. Delete cascades frames and assignments with no warning.
preconditions: canEdit; shots.length greater than 1 locally (otherwise defer dialog)
code_path: handleDeleteShot -> shotService.deleteShot -> DELETE /shots/:shotId -> count check (409 LAST_SHOT) -> DELETE shots row filtered by scene_id
data_touched: shots (delete) and cascaded frames, video_generation_jobs, image_generation_jobs, transformation_events, shot_asset_assignments, location_match_events
downstream: None in code for Stage 9-12 stage locks (contrast with split)

title: Defer scene from last-shot dialog
summary: When the only shot is selected for deletion, a dialog offers to defer the whole scene (sidelines it) and return to Script Hub.
notes: Defer route is owned by V6 scene slice; cited here only for the Stage 7 entry.
entrypoint: Last Shot in Scene dialog Defer Scene button
preconditions: Shot count 1 locally or 409 LAST_SHOT from delete

title: Lock shot list and proceed to Stage 8
summary: Lock flushes pending edits, runs local then server validation (errors block, warnings need Lock Anyway), sets scene shot_list_locked_at and stage_locks 7, then navigates forward. Stage 7 lock is written by three separate calls.
notes: Lock route tests are all it.skip except the 401 case. Backend shot mutation routes do not check the lock. Lock is idempotent when already locked.
entrypoint: Stage 7 footer Lock Shot List and Proceed button
preconditions: canEdit; shots non-empty; server errors empty; warnings empty or force true
code_path: handleLockShotList -> flush PUTs -> validateShotsLocally -> lockShotList -> POST /shots/lock -> validateShots (shotValidationService) + buildShotLocationValidationSummary -> scenes update with shot_list_locked_at and stage_locks 7 -> lockStageViaHook -> POST /stage-locks/7/lock -> onComplete -> ProjectView handleSceneStageComplete -> POST /stage-locks/7/lock again
data_touched: scenes (shot_list_locked_at, updated_at, stage_locks, status via trigger)
downstream: Stage 8 becomes reachable; stage 7 footer and edit controls disabled

title: Unlock Stage 7 with downstream impact confirmation
summary: Unlock is two-phase: the first call returns frame and video counts and an estimated cost, the confirm call sets stage 7 to draft and marks locked downstream stages outdated. A second legacy unlock call always fails and is ignored.
notes: Legacy /shots/unlock returns 400 'Shot list is not locked' because the stage-locks call already cleared shot_list_locked_at; the UI swallows this. Impact counts query a videos table not created by any migration (UNKNOWN in live DB). Downstream-stage-only cascade: stage 7 is not marked outdated.
entrypoint: LockedStageHeader Unlock and edit button, then UnlockWarningDialog confirm
preconditions: Stage 7 status locked (or outdated, which takes the same header path)
code_path: handleUnlockAndEdit -> unlockStage (POST /stage-locks/7/unlock confirm false, 409 impact) -> UnlockWarningDialog -> handleConfirmUnlock -> confirmUnlock (POST confirm true) -> stage_locks and shot_list_locked_at update -> best-effort shotService.unlockShotList (POST /shots/unlock, 400 ignored)
data_touched: scenes (shot_list_locked_at null, stage_locks, status via trigger); read-only counts on frames and videos (status not equal invalidated)
downstream: Stages 8-12 with locked or outdated status become outdated; prompts, frames, videos and assignments are not deleted

title: Re-lock Stage 7 when outdated
summary: Relock button exists for stage 7 in outdated state, calling the stage-locks relock route. No code path produces a stage 7 outdated state, so the control is effectively unreachable.
notes: Unlock cascade only touches stages greater than the unlocked stage, so unlocking stage 7 never sets stage 7 itself to outdated. invalidateStage9AndDownstream only touches 9-12. Reachable only if a stage 7 outdated value is written manually.
code_path: handleRelock -> relockStage -> POST /stage-locks/7/relock -> sets stage 7 locked and shot_list_locked_at

title: Assign or clear a camera direction for a shot
summary: Stage 8 location coverage panel assigns a location_views direction to a shot (or clears it), which also sets the shot's location to the direction's parent location. Owned by the V7 UI; the shot-side endpoint is documented here.
notes: Set path returns 409 when manual location conflicts; clear path re-resolves location unless manual. No lock check. No match event recorded on this route. Test covers set path only.
preconditions: Direction view type direction; direction asset is a location on active branch; not manual conflict
code_path: assignCameraDirection -> PUT /shots/:shotId/camera-direction -> location_views select -> project_assets select -> optional applyShotLocationResolution (clear) -> shots update (camera_direction_id, location_asset_id, location_match_*)

downstream: Stage 9 continuity and prompt generation read camera_direction_id and location_asset_id

title: Auto-populate shot-asset assignments on Stage 8 and Stage 9 load
summary: When a scene has assets and no assignments, the first Stage 8 or Stage 9 mount creates a throughout assignment for every shot by asset pair.
notes: Only runs when zero assignments exist; assets added later get no auto assignments unless added via AssetDrawer checklist. Hook itself untested.
entrypoint: useShotAssetAutoPopulate effect on Stage 8 and Stage 9 mount
preconditions: enabled flag (Stage 8: shots and assets loaded; Stage 9: assets and zero assignments and version 0); hasAssignments false
code_path: hook -> shotAssetAssignmentService.hasAssignments (GET has-assignments) -> autoPopulate (POST auto-populate) -> shot_asset_assignments insert of missing pairs with presence throughout -> onPopulated toast and version bump
downstream: Prompt generation treats all assigned pairs as throughout until edited

title: Change presence type of an asset on a shot (Stage 9 panel)
summary: Per-shot Assets panel lets the user change a single assignment between throughout, enters, exits and passes through.
notes: Errors only console.error. Invalidates Stage 9-12 locks on success.
code_path: handlePresenceChange -> shotAssetAssignmentService.updateAssignment -> PUT /shot-assignments/:assignmentId -> validate zod enum -> shotAssetAssignmentService.updateAssignment -> invalidateStage9AndDownstream (fire and forget)
downstream: Stage 9 prompt generation on next Generate; continuity preview

title: Remove an asset from a shot (Stage 9 panel)
summary: Trash icon opens a confirmation and deletes the single shot-asset assignment row.
notes: Route ownership check does not verify the assignment belongs to the scene (see V8-INV-06).
entrypoint: ShotAssetPanel trash button then AlertDialog Remove
downstream: Prompt generation ignores removed asset for this shot

title: Add an asset to a shot (Stage 9 panel)
summary: Add Asset popover lists scene assets not yet assigned to the shot and creates a throughout assignment on selection.
notes: Backend uses upsert onConflict shot_id,scene_asset_instance_id, so re-adding is idempotent. Route validates shotId and instanceId as UUIDs.

downstream: Prompt generation includes asset in start or end manifest per presence type

title: Split shot because it contains a passes-through asset
summary: Amber warning appears when any assignment is passes_through, offering a Split Shot action that calls the AI split route with default count.
notes: Stage 9 does not pass onShotSplit, so prompt cards are not reloaded after split (only assignments reload). Shot UUID in prompt set becomes stale until page reload.

data_touched: shots, shot_asset_assignments (clone), frames and jobs of original cascaded, scenes.stage_locks
downstream: Stage 9 prompt set for original shot is stale

title: Timeline matrix: cycle shot by asset presence
summary: Timeline view shows assets as rows and shots as columns; each click cycles the cell through none, throughout, enters, exits, passes through, then back to none (delete).
notes: Timeline test file re-implements the cycle logic and does not import the component, so the component is untested. Column header shows ps.shotId label.
entrypoint: Stage 9 view toggle set to timeline
preconditions: Prompt sets with shotUuid and at least one scene asset

title: Bulk presence templates (replace all assignments in scene)
summary: Template selector with Apply deletes every assignment in the scene and recreates them from a template. Because the bulk-delete route is shadowed by the single-assignment delete route, the first step fails and no assignments are recreated.
notes: Static inference (Express matches DELETE /:assignmentId before DELETE /all, so id equals all fails as invalid uuid); runtime not verified. Template pure logic tested; apply path untested.
entrypoint: Stage 9 header Bulk template select then Apply then AlertDialog Apply Template
code_path: handleApply -> deleteAllForScene -> DELETE /shot-assignments/all (matches /:assignmentId route first) -> error thrown before createAssignments

title: Choose shots when adding an asset in AssetDrawer
summary: When shots exist, adding an asset opens a checklist preselected by the heuristic matcher and creates the scene instance plus throughout assignments for the selected shots.
notes: Instance creation is V5/V6 route; this slice owns the assignment step. Falls back to all shots selected when no heuristic match. Assignment failure after instance creation leaves instance without assignments.
downstream: Prompt generation scoping for chosen shots

title: Stage 7 shot list lock state
summary: Locking sets scenes.shot_list_locked_at and stage_locks['7'] to locked. The DB trigger then sets status to shot_list_ready. Shot content is not frozen by the backend.
notes: Two writes can disagree if one fails; lock route ignores stage_locks write error paths beyond 500. Forced-lock metadata commented out.
trigger: POST /shots/lock success; POST /stage-locks/7/lock (called by Stage 7 hook and ProjectView complete)
precondition: Scene on active branch; for /shots/lock: no validation errors and either no warnings or force true; shot_list_locked_at currently null for race guard
side_effects: scenes.shot_list_locked_at=now, updated_at=now, stage_locks['7']={status:locked,locked_at}; DB trigger sets status shot_list_ready
preserves: shots rows, frame and video prompts, frames, assignments, stage 8-12 lock entries
ui_signal: Stage 7 footer hidden and LockedStageHeader shown; isSceneLocked true; edit controls disabled

title: Stage 7 unlock cascade to downstream stages
summary: Confirmed unlock sets stage 7 to draft and marks locked or outdated stages 8-12 as outdated. Shot rows, frames, videos and prompts are untouched.
notes: Downstream cascade only when stage 7 is not draft. Stages with status draft are left alone. Legacy unlock invalidation of frames and videos is unreachable from UI.
precondition: stage_locks['7'] status not draft or missing
side_effects: stage_locks['7']={status:draft}; stages 8-12 with locked or outdated become outdated; shot_list_locked_at=null; DB trigger reverts status to draft only if it was shot_list_ready
preserves: shots, frames, videos, prompts, assignments, camera directions, location views
ui_signal: UnlockWarningDialog counts then header switches to editable; stage 8 onward shows outdated if locked

title: Stage 9-12 outdated marking after assignment or split changes
summary: Any successful assignment create, update, delete, bulk delete, or shot split marks locked Stage 9-12 entries outdated in stage_locks. Merge and single-shot delete do not call it.
notes: Fire-and-forget; errors only warned. Only status locked is converted (drops locked_at); outdated and draft entries untouched. Stage 9 prompt rows are not deleted.
trigger: Successful POST, PUT, DELETE on shot-assignments; DELETE all (if reached); split route success
precondition: stage_locks entries for 9-12 with status locked
side_effects: stage_locks[9..12] with locked become {status:outdated}; updated_at set on scene
ui_signal: Stage header shows outdated on next load of that stage

title: DB trigger syncing scene status with shot_list_locked_at
summary: BEFORE UPDATE trigger on scenes sets status to shot_list_ready when shot_list_locked_at goes null to non-null, and to draft when it goes non-null to null only if status was shot_list_ready.
notes: Defined only in migration 014. Application code comments reference it as defense-in-depth. Status frames_locked is never written by application code. Trigger not tested.
trigger: Any UPDATE on scenes changing shot_list_locked_at null-ness
precondition: OLD and NEW shot_list_locked_at differ in null-ness
side_effects: NEW.status set to shot_list_ready (lock) or draft (unlock from shot_list_ready)
preserves: status values frames_locked and video_complete on unlock

title: Shot content edit has no downstream invalidation
summary: PUT of shot content fields updates only the shots row (plus location fields when setting or direction changes). Prompts, frames and videos are neither marked stale nor compared by timestamp.
notes: Frame prompt generated earlier stays as-is after shot action or camera edits. No version or staleness field compares shots.updated_at with prompts_generated_at (grep empty).
precondition: Shot belongs to scene; fields in whitelist
side_effects: shots update with updated_at trigger; if setting or camera_direction_id in payload and location_match_source not manual, location_* fields rewritten; location_match_events insert
ui_signal: Saving indicator; Unsaved changes footer text while pending

title: Shot order sequence after split, merge and delete
summary: shot_order is integer per scene with no uniqueness constraint. Split shifts later shots by N-1, merge shifts later shots by -1, delete does not compact, leaving gaps that affect merge neighbour lookup.
notes: Shift updates are sequential per row, non-atomic. Reorder route can restore order but has no UI caller.
side_effects: shot_order values of later shots changed or left with gaps
ui_signal: Shot list ordering on next fetch (ORDER BY shot_order)

title: Split invalidates Stage 9-12 but merge does not
summary: Split route calls invalidateStage9AndDownstream after success, while merge and single delete skip it even though they also replace shots and cascade-delete their frames and prompts.
notes: Comment in split route refers to section 6 spec. Invalidation is fire-and-forget (errors only warned).
preserves: Frames of the original shot are already cascade-deleted by the shot delete (see V8-INV-03)

title: Stage 7 lock does not gate backend shot mutation routes
summary: Lock state is enforced only in the frontend through canEdit. PUT shot, split, merge, delete, reorder, camera-direction, location and assignment routes do not read shot_list_locked_at or stage_locks.
notes: Stage 9 ShotAssetPanel split and assignment edits can mutate a Stage 7 locked list. Confirmed by grep: only the lock and unlock routes read the lock fields.
trigger: Any shot mutation request while scene is locked
ui_signal: Only UI canEdit disables controls; Stage 9 has no lock check

title: Shot row delete cascades to frames, jobs, transformation events, and assignments
summary: Deleting a shot row (split, merge, single delete) cascades to every table with ON DELETE CASCADE on shot_id, and sets completion_shot_id to null on transformation events and camera direction link to null on the other side.
notes: No confirmation in UI for single delete. Split and merge delete the original rows. Frames rows with approved or generated content are removed with no warning. location_views.camera_direction_id on shots uses SET NULL for the view side.
side_effects: Cascade delete of frames (019), video_generation_jobs (021), image_generation_jobs (007), transformation_events where trigger_shot_id (030), shot_asset_assignments (033), location_match_events (039); completion_shot_id set null (030)
invalidates: All downstream generated artifacts for the shot
ui_signal: None (no confirmation); shot disappears from list

title: Merge and single delete leave Stage 9-12 locks unchanged
summary: Unlike split and assignment routes, merge and delete never mark Stage 9-12 outdated, so locked downstream stages remain locked after their shots and prompts were removed.
notes: Absence of call, verified by reading both routes in full. Whether this is intended is UNKNOWN; source comment in split implies section 6 rule applies to split only.
invalidates: Nothing (should per cascade but does not)

title: Unlock cascade does not delete artifacts and does not reach stage 7
summary: Stage unlock marks downstream locked stages outdated and never deletes frames, videos or prompts. Stage 7 itself is set to draft, never outdated, so the stage 7 relock path has no producer.
notes: Test for impact-required case is it.skip. Frame count query excludes invalidated frames; legacy path writes invalidated status which the frames CHECK constraint does not allow.
invalidates: Lock status of stages above unlocked stage

title: Assignment routes do not scope target IDs to the path scene
summary: Assignment PUT and DELETE check only that the project owns the scene path, then mutate any assignment by id via service-role client. Shot and instance ids in POST are not checked against the scene.
notes: Service-role key bypasses RLS, so the RLS policies on shot_asset_assignments do not apply to backend calls. Cross-scene mutation would require a valid authenticated user with at least one owned project and scene id.
precondition: Authenticated user owns the project in path and the scene exists on some branch
side_effects: Row mutation of any assignment id
invalidates: Stage 9-12 of the path scene (not the target scene)

title: Shot validation thresholds used by lock gate
summary: Server and client share thresholds: duration below 1 or above 30 is an error; below 4 or above 12 is a warning; scene total below 4 per shot or above 15 per shot is a warning; unexpected characters warn with Levenshtein distance below 3 suggestion.
notes: Verbatim server messages: 'Minimum duration is 1 second (API limit)', 'Maximum duration is 30 seconds (quality threshold)', 'Duration Ns is very short. Quick cuts work for action but may feel rushed for dialogue.', 'Duration Ns is unusually long. Long takes can be powerful but risk viewer attention.'. Server validation runs only on server lock; client validation is a second copy with shorter messages. Background characters are not checked.

title: Split assigns original duration to every new shot
summary: Split keeps each new shot at the full original duration, so the scene total grows by (N-1) times the original duration. Split prompt text tells the model that durations are set server-side.
notes: Stated purpose in code: each clip can use full generator time limit (per-clip generator limits). Test asserts duration 8 for 8-second original.

title: Merge sums durations and suffixes -M
summary: Merged shot duration is the sum of both durations, shot_id is first shot id with suffix -M, and beat_reference is inherited from the earlier shot. Continuity flags come from AI output.
notes: Two 8-second shots merge to 16 seconds, which triggers the over-12-second warning on next lock. Merge also drops camera_* fields.

title: Last shot cannot be deleted; UI offers scene defer
summary: Backend returns 409 with code LAST_SHOT and suggestion defer_scene when deleting the only shot. The UI checks locally first and opens the defer dialog.
notes: Counts are computed twice; first count variable unused.

title: Merge neighbour is exact shot_order plus or minus one
summary: Merge looks up the neighbour with shot_order equal to current plus or minus one. Gaps left by delete return 400 'No next/previous shot to merge with'.
notes: UI computes adjacency from array index, so the UI can enable Merge while the backend rejects it.

title: No manual add-shot route or UI
summary: Shots are created only by AI extraction (empty scene), AI split, and AI merge. No route or control creates a blank shot.
evidence: backend/src/routes/projects.ts:1534-2840 (no POST on shots collection except /extract)
src/components/pipeline/Stage7ShotList.tsx:4 (Plus icon imported but unused as add control)
notes: Manual add: N. Only POST on the shots collection is /extract.

title: Presence types map to start and end frame manifests
summary: throughout assigns to start and end, enters to end only, exits to start only, passes_through to video-only. Locations always go to start and end. Unassigned assets default to throughout when assignments exist for the shot.
notes: Consumed by V9 prompt generation. No unit test for buildFrameReferenceManifests in V8 test set. Video prompt receives TEMPORAL PRESENCE NOTES lines: 'X enters the frame during this shot.', 'X exits the frame during this shot.', 'Briefly during this shot, X (desc) passes through the scene.'

title: Shot with zero assignments falls back to all non-location assets
summary: scopeAssetsForShotContinuity keeps all non-location assets when a shot has no assignments, but when any assignments exist for that shot only assigned assets remain. Location assets pass only when they match the shot's canonical location_asset_id.
notes: Auto-populate reduces the zero-assignment case to shots added after population.

title: Shot model has no lineage, blocking, or previs columns
summary: Shot identity is the shot_id text label. Split and merge encode lineage only in the suffix (-1, -2, -M). No parent_id, split_from, merged_from, blocking, or previs columns exist in any migration.
notes: Grep for parent_shot, split_from, merged_from, ref_image_num returned nothing. ref_image_num is not a column; migration 028 names reference_image_order and end_frame_prompt.

title: transformation_flags is written but never read
summary: Extraction stores the AI transformation flags as JSON on shots.transformation_flags. No code reads that column and the frontend Shot.transformationFlags is never populated from the API.
notes: Transformation detection is consumed through transformation_events created elsewhere (V-transformation slice), not through this column. Migration comment labels column as Stage 7 staging data.

title: Camera structured fields are AI-only in Stage 7
summary: camera_distance, camera_height, and camera_movement are populated from LLM output or regex fallback at extraction. The Stage 7 UI does not edit them; only the free-text camera field is editable.
notes: Editing camera free text does not re-derive structured fields. Split and merge do not carry them.

title: Shot IDs are generated per scene by index
summary: Extraction assigns shot_id as scene number plus letters (1A, 1B, ... 1AA). Letters reset per scene. LLM shot_order is ignored.
notes: Re-extraction into a scene that has shots would collide on UNIQUE(scene_id, shot_id). Inferred from schema, not runtime-verified.

title: Extraction failure modes return empty shots
summary: Timeout (20 s race) and double parse failure return an empty shot list rather than error. The UI turns an empty result into an error screen. Rate limit is rethrown as 429.
notes: Timeout test mocks rejection directly rather than exercising the race. Race timer is not cleared, so background timer can leak.

title: Split count of 3 and merge guidance are not reachable from UI
summary: splitCount 3 and merge userGuidance are supported by the backend and client service signatures but no UI passes them.
notes: Dialog text in UI says 'two coherent shots' only.

title: llm-client retry and model defaults
summary: llm-client generate retries retryable errors three times with exponential backoff (1 s base, multiplier 2, cap 10 s). Model resolves to env GEMINI_MODEL or gemini-1.5-flash, while the constructor default is gemini-2.5-flash-lite. Env value UNKNOWN.
notes: Retries continue after the 20 s race fires, so background calls can complete with results discarded.

title: Stage 7 shot routes (projects.ts)
summary: Mounted shot routes: GET shots, POST extract, PUT reorder, POST resolve-locations, PUT camera-direction, PUT location, PUT shot, POST split, POST merge, DELETE shot, POST lock, POST unlock. All require auth and project ownership; none check lock state except lock and unlock.
notes: Route file mounted at /api/projects with authenticateUser (server.ts:49). Location routes (resolve-locations, location) owned by V7.

title: Shot-asset assignment routes
summary: Routes at /api/projects/:projectId/scenes/:sceneId/shot-assignments: GET list, GET per shot (orphaned), POST create (upsert), PUT presence, DELETE one, DELETE all (shadowed), POST auto-populate, GET has-assignments.
notes: Each mutation invalidates Stage 9-12 locks fire-and-forget. Only service-level tests exist; route tests absent.

title: DELETE /shot-assignments/all is shadowed
summary: The bulk delete route is registered after DELETE /:assignmentId, so Express routes the request to the single-delete handler with assignmentId set to all. The bulk delete handler is never reached.
notes: Static inference from route registration order; runtime error text UNKNOWN.

title: Shot extraction and split service tests
summary: Backend tests cover generateShotId, ShotExtractionService parse, invalid-shot discard, camera metadata fallback, timeout returning empty, and ShotSplitService two-way ids and duration. They mock llm-client.
notes: Merge service, retry prompt path, and three-way split not covered.

title: Shot validation tests
summary: Service-level tests cover empty list, duplicate ids, required fields, duration bounds and warnings, character name warnings and typo suggestion, total duration bounds, and valid list.
notes: Two near-duplicate test files. Route-level lock behavior not tested here.

title: Lock and unlock route tests
summary: Only the 401 unauthenticated cases run. All DB-backed lock, unlock, 409 and 400 cases are it.skip with placeholder project/scene IDs from env.
notes: Lock behavior is effectively untested in-repo.

title: Shot-asset assignment service tests
summary: Backend service tests cover get, create default and explicit presence, bulk upsert, update, delete, autoPopulate dedupe, hasAssignments, invalidateStage9AndDownstream (9-12 only), and deleteAllForScene. Route-level behavior not tested.
notes: Mocked supabase; the shadowed DELETE /all route is not exercised.

title: Shot location route integration tests
summary: Integration tests for PUT shot setting resolver persistence, manual location, batch resolve preserving manual, Stage 8 coverage response, and camera-direction assignment using mocked supabase and the real server app.
notes: Shared with V7 slice; listed here only for PUT shot and camera-direction behavior.

title: Frontend Stage 9 tests (partial coverage)
summary: BulkPresenceTemplates.test imports real buildTemplateAssignments. ShotAssetTimeline.test does not import the component and re-implements cycle and color logic. shotAssetMatcher.test covers confidence values. No tests for Stage7ShotList, ShotAssetPanel, or the auto-populate hook.
notes: Timeline tests verify copies of logic, not the rendered component.

title: Frame-to-shot embed regression guard
summary: Static test scans three service and route files for unqualified shots embeds in frames queries and requires the explicit shots!frames_shot_id_fkey relationship name.
notes: Guards against PGRST201 caused by migration 040 selected_continuity_base_frame_id FK.

title: shots table
summary: Scene-scoped shot rows keyed by UUID with unique (scene_id, shot_id) label. Holds action, dialogue, characters, setting, camera, structured camera fields, location identity fields, order, duration, and prompt, end-frame, continuity, and transformation columns added by later migrations.
notes: RLS policies on shots exist (migration 006). Backend uses service-role key. No CHECK constraints on camera_distance, camera_height, or camera_movement. end_frame_reference_image_order added in 039 as compatibility fix.

title: shot_asset_assignments table
summary: Join table from shots to scene_asset_instances with presence_type enum and unique pair. Cascades on both sides.
notes: Used by V5 asset merge and V-transformation inference; those consumers are cross-slice.

title: Scene lock fields (scenes)
summary: Scene-level lock state is held in shot_list_locked_at (migration 014), stage_locks JSONB (only in quickies-sql/add_stage_locks.sql, not a numbered migration), and status enum with values including frames_locked and video_complete.
notes: Two stores for stage 7 lock. Stage_locks column absent from numbered migrations; fresh DB built from migrations would lack it (UNKNOWN which DB state is canonical).

title: Shot label scheme
summary: shot_id text labels: extraction produces {scene}{letter} (1A), split produces {orig}-1 and {orig}-2 (or -3), merge produces {first}-M. Labels are used as keys in validation duplicate checks and in UI error navigation.
notes: Split of a split yields names like 1A-1-2. Duplicate check operates on shot_id label not UUID.

title: Shot camera direction and location link fields
summary: shots.camera_direction_id (FK location_views SET NULL) and location_asset_id/location_match_* fields are the Stage 7/8 link from a shot to a location and camera direction. Written by extraction, PUT shot, camera-direction route, and V7 location routes.
notes: Field semantics owned by V7; listed for the shot-side identity.

title: Shot reorder endpoint and client have no caller
summary: PUT /shots/reorder validates ids and sets shot_order, and shotService.reorderShots wraps it, but no UI component calls reorderShots.
notes: Grep for reorderShots in src returns only the definition.

title: Per-shot assignment list has no caller
summary: GET /shot-assignments/shots/:shotId and frontend listForShot are never called. Backend createAssignment single-create is only used by tests.
notes: Stage 9 uses listForScene and per-shot grouping client-side.

title: transformation_flags column and Shot.transformationFlags are never consumed
summary: Extraction writes transformation_flags to shots and the TypeScript Shot type declares transformationFlags, but no read path exists.
notes: Staging data per migration 030 comment.

title: Legacy shots/unlock invalidation branch unreachable from UI
summary: POST /shots/unlock performs frames and videos invalidation and writes invalidation_logs, but UI calls it only after stage-locks unlock has already cleared shot_list_locked_at, so it always returns 400. Its status writes conflict with frames CHECK constraint and videos/invalidation_logs have no migrations.
notes: Existence of videos and invalidation_logs tables in live DB: UNKNOWN.

title: Stage 7 relock path has no producer of outdated status
summary: Relock is reachable only when stage_locks['7'] is outdated, and no code path writes outdated to stage 7.
notes: Duplicate of V8-CAP-09 at data level.
